facts.title: crusty baked cauliflower and farro
ingredients: 2 1/4 to 2 1/2 pound (1 to 1 1/8 kgs) head of cauliflower, cut into small florets
2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh sage leaves
2 large or 3 regular cloves garlic, minced
Crushed red pepper flakes, to taste
2 cups (6 ounces or 170 grams) coarsely grated, lightly packed Italian Fontina (buy about 8 ounces with rind)
1/3 cup (30 grams) finely grated pecorino romano cheese
2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley leaves
facts.author: Deb Perelman
